title: Spanish Tortilla
subtitle: Potato and onion omelette
excerpt: Thin-sliced potatoes and sweet onions set in eggs and cooked slowly until golden. This is one of the great simple dishes, good hot, warm, or at room temperature.
sourceNotes: Based on the classic Spanish tortilla de patatas, cooked low and slow in olive oil with a brave flip to finish.

recipe.makeAheadNotes: Keeps well at room temperature for up to 4 hours, making it ideal for picnics or packed lunches.

content.text: The potatoes are cooked slowly in the oil, not deep-fried. They should be tender and silky, not crisp. Use a plate larger than the pan to flip the tortilla.

items.prepNote: peeled and sliced as thin as possible
beaten with a generous pinch of salt

content.text: Pour the olive oil into a 28cm frying pan over low-medium heat.
Add the potato slices and onion. Season with salt. Cook for 25 minutes, turning gently every few minutes, until the potato is completely tender.
Drain the potato and onion through a sieve, catching the oil in a bowl. Leave to cool for 5 minutes.
Tip the potato and onion into the beaten eggs. Stir gently and leave for 5 minutes.
Return 2 tbsp of the saved oil to the pan over medium heat. Pour in the egg and potato mixture. Level the top with a spatula.
Cook for 6 minutes until the edges are set. The centre will still be wobbly.
Place a large plate over the pan. Flip the tortilla onto the plate in one confident move.
Slide the tortilla back into the pan, uncooked side down. Cook for 4 more minutes until just set in the centre.
Slide onto a board. Rest for 5 minutes before cutting into wedges.

items.symptom: Tortilla stuck to the pan when flipping.
items.cause: Not enough oil or pan not non-stick enough.
items.fix: Add a little oil and loosen the edges before flipping.

items.symptom: Centre is raw after two cooks.
items.cause: Too thick a layer or heat too high.
items.fix: Cover and cook over very low heat for 3 more minutes.

items.cause: Not cooked long enough in the oil stage.
items.fix: Slow-cook for a further 10 minutes before adding the eggs.
